snippets: Developed an admin dashboard in React and Next.js that allowed OB/GYN doctors to manage their patients, including insights, billing, and treatments.
Built an accessible design system in Tailwind and Storybook that reflected the brand’s identity, including components such as MultiSelect and Autocomplete.
Added multilingual capabilities to the app (i18n), making French speakers feel right at home, which made it easier for doctors from both France and the US to onboard.
